Requested process:
Create a readable directed flowchart for the following process. Use exactly the quoted stage labels. The first stage is a start node, the last is an end node, any explicitly named decision is a decision node, and all other stages are process nodes. Label decision branches exactly Yes and No. Do not add stages or connections. Begin with "Delivery planning begins", then "Read destination", then the decision "Destination local?". Its Yes branch goes to "Assign bicycle courier"; its No branch goes to "Assign van courier". Both alternative stages lead directly to "Send route details", which leads to "Delivery planning complete".
